title: Godot not responding when auto creating tiles with atlas's using tilemaplayers's.
body:
### Tested versions

-reproducible in 4.5.stable 
-reproducible in 4.5.1.stable

### System information

Windows 11 - godot v4.5.stable - opengl

### Issue description

When auto creating tiles in non-transparent regions with atlas's in tilemaplayers Godot will stop responding and if it does come back will immediately stop responding again after. When running via console it it spits out these error messages (refer to text below this paragraph, top is when im in the project selector (after the auto create pop up appears nothing else happens and godot freezes)) 

```
Godot Engine v4.5.stable.official.876b29033 - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL API 3.3.0 Core Profile Context 23.19.18.01.240820 - Compatibility - Using Device: ATI Technologies Inc. - AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics

WARNING: Not a PNG file
     at: check_error (drivers/png/png_driver_common.cpp:55)
ERROR: Condition "!success" is true. Returning: ERR_FILE_CORRUPT
   at: png_to_image (drivers/png/png_driver_common.cpp:68)
ERROR: Error loading image: 'C:/Users/dougl/Downloads/godot4-third-person-controller-main/godot4-third-person-controller-main/icon.png'.
   at: load_image (core/io/image_loader.cpp:100)
Editing project: C:/Users/dougl/OneDrive/Documents/balloonis
Godot Engine v4.5.stable.official.876b29033 - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.3.260 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: AMD - AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics

Godot Engine v4.5.stable.official.876b29033 - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.3.260 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: AMD - AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics
```


### Steps to reproduce

-add tileset to tilemaplayer
-add a atlas (using a image with parts seperated by transparent pixels)
-thats it

N/A
